title: Langley RCMP to share details on major investigation, arrests related to extortion and violence

blocks.text: Langley RCMP to announce 'significant criminal charges' after extortion investigation

Langley RCMP Supt. Harm Dosange and Chief Supt. Duncan Pound, assistant district commander representing the B.C. Extortion Task Force, will share details on what police say is a major investigation into extortion and violence called "Project E_PURSUANCE."

items: Langley RCMP say they will share details of a major investigation into allegations of extortion and violence that has led to multiple arrests and "significant criminal charges."

blocks.text: There are no updates at the moment. They will appear here as soon as they are available. Stay tuned!
